items.x: ReptiDay Sarasota returns Oct. 31, offering a closer look at snakes, lizards and other exotic animals while helping visitors overcome fears and learn about reptile care.

items.t: 'How did we get to that place?' Father of deceased hostage speaks out after Israel's elections
items.x: As elections conclude in Israel, a critical issue remaining for families of those killed and taken hostage on October 7th is accountability. Many want an inquiry into internal security failures.

items.t: Cracked: In South Texas, new Congressional lines divide neighbors
items.x: Neighbors on the same street in Corpus Christi, Texas, will soon have different representatives in Congress. A new Republican-drawn map is dividing communities, and some residents aren't happy.

items.t: World Series brings surge of baseball fans to Tampa International Airport
items.x: It's also delivering a major boost in passenger traffic at Tampa International Airport as baseball fans travel from across the country and around the world to watch the Tampa Bay Rays take on the Milwaukee Brewers.

items.t: ‘I miss her like crazy’: Loved ones remembering post office worker hit and killed by car
items.x: Loved ones and a Kentucky community are mourning a post office worker who was hit and killed by a car while walking earlier this month.

items.t: Report: Peltola campaign linked to effort to recruit second Dan Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
items.x: Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in efforts to recruit a second Dan Sullivan for Alaska's Senate race, The New York Times reports. The candidate is now on the ballot alongside the GOP incumbent.
